3. Configuration

3.1. MinIO Server Configuration

The main MinIO service is configured through docker-compose.yaml:

 1version: "3.8"
 2
 3services:
 4  dvc-minio:
 5    image: minio/minio:RELEASE.2025-02-28T09-55-16Z
 6    command: server /data --console-address ":9001"
 7    restart: always
 8    environment:
 9      - MINIO_ROOT_USER=DVC
10      - MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD=uTAntEMTuVpcJucNjOJm
11      - MINIO_CERT_PUBLIC_KEY=/root/.minio/certs/public.crt
12      - MINIO_CERT_PRIVATE_KEY=/root/.minio/certs/private.key
13      # - MINIO_DEFAULT_BUCKETS=datasets
14    ports:
15      - "30706:9000" # Port S3 : 30702
16      - "30707:9001" # Admin port: 30703
17    volumes:
18      - ./DVC_data:/data
19      - ./certs:/root/.minio/certs

3.1.1. Key Configuration Options

3.1.1.1. Environment Variables

  • MINIO_ROOT_USER: Administrator username

  • MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD: Administrator password (minimum 8 characters)

  • MINIO_CERT_PUBLIC_KEY: Path to public certificate file

  • MINIO_CERT_PRIVATE_KEY: Path to private key file

3.1.1.2. Port Configuration

  • 30706:9000: S3 API port mapping

  • 30707:9001: Web console port mapping

3.1.1.3. Volume Mounts

  • ./DVC_data:/data: Persistent data storage

  • ./certs:/root/.minio/certs: SSL certificate directory

3.2. SSL Certificate Configuration

3.2.1. Certificate Generation

SSL certificates are generated using the OpenSSL configuration in openssl/nginx/conf/openssl_wisrovi.cnf:

 1[ req ]
 2default_bits       = 4096
 3prompt             = no
 4default_md         = sha256
 5distinguished_name = dn
 6x509_extensions    = v3_req
 7
 8[ dn ]
 9C  = ES
10ST = Badajoz
11L  = Badajoz
12O  = Wisrovi Rodriguez
13OU = Autor Independiente
14CN = www.dvc.ecapturedtech.com
15emailAddress = wrodriguez@ecapturedtech.com
16
17[ v3_req ]
18subjectAltName = @alt_names
191.3.6.1.4.1.311.20.2.3 = ASN1:UTF8String:https://ecapturedtech.com/
20
21[ alt_names ]
22URI.1 = https://ecapturedtech.com/

3.2.2. Certificate Details

  • Algorithm: RSA 4096-bit

  • Validity: 825 days

  • Domain: www.dvc.ecapturedtech.com

  • Subject Alternative Names: https://ecapturedtech.com/

3.3. Docker Image Configuration

The certificate generation uses a custom Docker image defined in openssl/nginx/Dockerfile:

 1# Usamos Debian como base para instalar OpenSSL
 2FROM debian:bullseye-slim
 3
 4# Instalamos OpenSSL
 5RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y openssl && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
 6
 7
 8WORKDIR /conf
 9COPY conf/openssl_wisrovi.cnf .
10
11# Definimos el directorio de trabajo donde OpenSSL guardará los certificados
12WORKDIR /data

3.4. Advanced Configuration

3.4.1. Custom Domain

To use a different domain:

  1. Edit openssl/nginx/conf/openssl_wisrovi.cnf

  2. Update the CN and subjectAltName fields

  3. Regenerate certificates

3.4.2. Custom Ports

Modify port mappings in docker-compose.yaml:

ports:
  - "9000:9000"  # S3 API
  - "9001:9001"  # Console

Note

Ensure the new ports are not already in use.

3.4.3. Data Directory

Change the data storage location:

volumes:
  - "/path/to/your/data:/data"

3.4.4. MinIO Version

Update to a specific MinIO version:

image: minio/minio:RELEASE.2023-01-01T00-00-00Z

3.4.5. Environment Variables

Additional MinIO configuration options:

environment:
  - MINIO_ROOT_USER=myuser
  - MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD=mysecurepassword
  - MINIO_REGION=us-west-1
  - MINIO_BROWSER_REDIRECT_URL=https://console.example.com

3.5. Production Considerations

3.5.1. SSL Certificates

For production deployments:

  1. Use certificates from a trusted Certificate Authority

  2. Implement certificate rotation policies

  3. Configure HSTS headers if using a web server proxy

3.5.2. Security Hardening

  • Change default credentials

  • Use strong, unique passwords

  • Implement network segmentation

  • Enable audit logging

  • Regular security updates

3.5.3. Backup Strategy

  • Regular backups of DVC_data/ directory

  • Test restore procedures

  • Offsite backup storage

  • Automated backup scripts

3.5.4. Monitoring

Consider implementing:

  • Health checks

  • Log aggregation

  • Performance monitoring

  • Alerting systems

3.5.5. High Availability

For production HA setup:

  • Multiple MinIO nodes

  • Load balancer configuration

  • Shared storage backend

  • Redundancy planning
